name: TOWA Corporation
blurb: TOWA Corporation designs, develops, manufactures, and sells semiconductor manufacturing equipment and high-precision molds in Japan and internationally. It operates through three segments: Semiconductor Manufacturing Equipment, Medical Device, and Laser Processing Equipment. The company is a key player in semiconductor packaging equipment, particularly in compression molding and singulation systems.
recent: Over the past month, TOWA's stock (TOWCF) has risen sharply, gaining over 15% on May 6, 2026, to close at $23.25, near its 52-week high. The company is scheduled to report earnings on May 11, 2026, which may be driving investor optimism. The stock has a 52-week range of $10.54 to $23.35, reflecting significant volatility.
